notes:
V3.1.5 — version-bug fix (third try), two truly-free AI providers, bot-library lock.

FIXES
• Version detection is now bulletproof. _bundled_version_file() tries every known location (sys._MEIPASS, exe_dir/_internal/, exe_dir/, source root) and returns the first one that exists. Added a one-time log line so any future regression is visible: 'Wed 22 May 23:42 [updater] version 3.1.5 (from C:/…)'. The header should now show v3.1.5 right after install and no longer suggest 'install v3.1.5' as an update on top of itself.

FREE AI PROVIDERS
• 🎁 Google Gemini — Gemini 2.5 Flash / Pro / 2.0 Flash. Free tier is 60 RPM and ~1500 requests/day. Get a key at aistudio.google.com/apikey.
• 🎁 Groq — Llama 3.3 70B / 3.1 8B / Mixtral 8×7B / Gemma 2 9B. Free tier ~14k tokens/min. Get a key at console.groq.com/keys.
• Provider dropdown distinguishes APEX-credits (charges 10 ◊/gen, uses balance) from provider-free-tier (uses your own free-tier key, costs nothing). Placeholder text in the key field points to where to grab a free key.
• Generation flow correctly skips the credit refresh for free-tier providers (no balance change happens).

BOT-LIBRARY LOCK
• New MORE BOTS section: 🔒 LIBRARY LOCK. One click encrypts every custom bot .py in DATA_DIR/bots → .apex (Fernet, AES-128-CBC with HMAC). Casual readers (File Explorer's preview pane, Notepad, sync utilities) can't open them. A second click decrypts.
• Running a locked bot: the desktop decrypts to a short-lived temp file (0600 permissions), spawns python on it, deletes the temp when the bot exits.
• Honest disclaimer in the UI: this is OBFUSCATION not vault-grade encryption. The Fernet key is baked into APEX.exe, so anyone with a disassembler can defeat it. For real isolation, run bots in cloud mode (Tools → AUTOMATION) where the bot source never lives on the user's filesystem.
• No effect on built-in bots — those are already compiled to .pyc inside APEX.exe.

Answer to 'can we use a free consumer Claude/ChatGPT account': no — those services don't expose user/password APIs, and scraping the consumer UI violates ToS + breaks weekly. The two free providers above are the proper alternatives.
